fields.name: relationshipId
fields.authorityReason: Every Follow relation is an independently addressable, auditable relation instance and its identifier is never reused.

fields.name: followerUserId
fields.authorityReason: The authoritative actor of a Follow relation must remain bound to exactly one ENT-USER identity for the relation lifetime.

fields.name: targetUserId
fields.authorityReason: The target of a Follow relation must remain bound to exactly one authoritative ENT-USER identity for the relation lifetime.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.authorityReason: Creation time supports stable pagination, audit lineage and deterministic relation ordering.

lifecycle.create: Canonical follow operation creates exactly one active relation after account, target, privacy, block and scope checks pass.
lifecycle.duplicateCreate: Duplicate follow converges to the existing active relation and returns the operation-defined idempotent success.
lifecycle.remove: Canonical unfollow operation atomically removes the active relation if present.
lifecycle.missingRemove: Removing a missing relation is an idempotent success.
lifecycle.identifier: relationshipId is never reused after relation removal.
lifecycle.derivedState: Follower/following counts and ranking/analytics state are rebuildable projections and are not stored as authoritative fields here.

security.targetSource: Request target is resolved against authoritative ENT-USER.
clientTrust: client cannot supply or overwrite relationship state

nonGoals: No D1 table or migration claim.
No cache as source of truth.
No VERIFIED promotion without persistence and executable evidence.

requiredEvidence: Evidence Registry record with validating commit SHA
verificationRequirements.promotionRule: Remain CONTRACTED_NOT_VERIFIED until the full executable persistence/runtime/evidence chain is admitted.
